latest_release.name: v4.0.544
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed

- `remotion`: Validate props against the composition `schema` during rendering by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13317
- `remotion`: Preserve subtrees when toggling loop and motion blur by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13381
- `remotion`: Keep `cancelRender()` fatal after releasing render holds by @alec-watts in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13353
- `remotion`: Restore `<HtmlInCanvas>` premounting on fixed Chromium by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13395
- `remotion`: Recover effects from initial WebGL context allocation failure by @alec-watts in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13400
- [`@remotion/lambda`: Allow deploying via Terraform](https://remotion.dev/docs/lambda/terraform) by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13308
- `@remotion/studio`: [Add OpenTimeline export option](https://www.remotion.dev/docs/export-opentimeline) by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13334
- `@remotion/studio`: See all guides at once in the inspector by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13324
- `@remotion/studio`: Make Settings and Elements fullscreen by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13335
- `@remotion/animation-utils`: Fix multi-keyframe loops in `interpolateStyles()` by @adityajai119 in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13364
- `@remotion/cli`: Fix `--license-key=free-license` being rejected by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13318
- `@remotion/cli`: Fail with composition list instead of hanging on picker without a TTY by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13321
- `@remotion/cli`: Fix still image format for uppercase file extensions by @adityajai119 in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13409
- `@remotion/fonts`: Fix `loadFont()` format detection for URLs with query strings by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13304
- `@remotion/google-fonts`: Add Agrave Pro and Firjar
- `@remotion/install-whisper-cpp`: Reject downloads that end before `Content-Length` by @DeryFerd in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13248
- `@remotion/lambda`: Keep writing chunk status after a failed write, send one final webhook by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13301
- `@remotion/lambda`: Declare mime-types as a runtime dependency by @keiffff in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13351
- `@remotion/lambda-client`: Check payload size in sync and streaming invocations by @DeryFerd in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13067
- `@remotion/lambda-client`: Fix `expressWebhook()` skipping callbacks with `express.raw()` by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13316
- `@remotion/lambda-go`: Fix `storageClass` and `isProduction` being dropped from the render payload by @DeryFerd in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13249
- `@remotion/layout-utils`: Add `fontVariantNumeric` to `measureText()` cache key by @adityajai119 in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13358
- `@remotion/lottie`: Fix empty first frame of `<Lottie direction="backward">` by @adityajai119 in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13405
- `@remotion/lottie`: Fix `getLottieMetadata()` duration for animations that don't start at frame 0 by @adityajai119 in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13407
- `@remotion/media`: Upgrade Mediabunny to 1.66.0 by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13398
- `@remotion/media`: Include package licenses and validate them in CI by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13337
- `@remotion/paths`: Fix `getBoundingBox()` leaving out a `T` curve after an arc by @adityajai119 in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13368
- `@remotion/renderer`: Show HTTP st

hot_issues.title: `@remotion/media`: `<Video>` still stalls at t=0.2s on Windows after #11018 — expose decoder `hardwareAcceleration`
Resumable, self-healing long local renders (chunk retry + wall-clock hang watchdog)
If playing a 30fps video at 4x speed, it plays at 60fps because of screen refresh frequency. Then the FPS counter becomes red.
`@remotion/web-renderer`: Remaining HLS and WebKit audio timing issues
`@remotion/player`: persistent audio/video offset after a brief audio-clock stall is never corrected

detail.readme: - **Make videos agentically**: Turn your idea into a video using your agent. - **Make videos interactively**: Edit and animate like in a regular video editor. - **Make videos programmatically**: Leverage web technology and own your video as code. ## Video Automation - **Design systems**: Create a library of animated assets for your organization. - **Batch rendering**: Render millions of videos on your own infrastructure. - **Applications**: Publish a simple tool or a complex video editor. ## Get started If you already have Node.JS installed, type ```console npx create-video@latest ``` to get started.
